range-of-tolerance.def: The range of values of an abiotic factor, such as temperature or salinity, that an organism or population can survive. Also called ecological tolerance. Each species has a range for each factor.

optimal-range.def: The part of a range of tolerance where individuals of a species grow, feed and reproduce best, so its population is largest.

zone-of-stress.def: The parts of a range of tolerance between the optimal range and the limits, where individuals survive but grow, feed or reproduce poorly. Beyond these zones lie the zones of intolerance, where individuals die.
